description: Hand-written Db2 rows covering the type rules of ADR 0005: CHAR padding (trailing and leading), VARCHAR trailing spaces, empty string vs NULL, NULL in every nullable column, DECIMAL(31,8) at full precision, DECIMAL(15,2) limits, TIMESTAMP(6) microseconds, DST-ambiguous and non-existent local times, DATE limits, BIGINT limits, quotes, pipes, backslashes, line breaks and text outside Windows-1252.
